Quotation EMW-2026-1187
Dear Procurement Team,
Thank you for your enquiry RFQ-FST-M8-SS. We are pleased to quote as follows for
M8 stainless hex bolts (A2-70, DIN 933), article FST-M8-SS.
For the requested quantity of 10,000 units we offer a unit price of USD 0.83.
On this order we apply a volume discount of 3 per cent, and freight to your
nominated forwarder is charged at USD 180.00. The resulting total for this
quotation is USD 8,231.00, excluding any local taxes and duties.
Our minimum order quantity for this article is 2,000 units. Delivery is
15 days from written order confirmation. Payment terms are Net 30 from
invoice date. Our current monthly capacity for this article is 40,000 units.
This quotation is valid until 31 October 2026. All prices are quoted in USD.
We would be glad to receive your order and remain at your disposal for any
question you may have.
Yours sincerely,
M. Brunner
Sales Director, Eiger Metallwerk GmbH
